name: juice-shop
description: OWASP Juice Shop (github.com/juice-shop/juice-shop) v20.2.0, verified against a live instance on 2026-09-01, run natively with `npm start` (no Docker). Its classic IDOR/BOLA is GET /rest/basket/{id}: any logged-in user can fetch any basket by id (retrieveBasket does no ownership check). metewise catches it in both directions with the victim's basket contents as evidence. /api/Products/{id} is public (served to anonymous clients) and must not be flagged.
